_readme: Editable source for a commercial invoice. Copy this file outside the repository (or to an untracked name), complete every field marked with [ ], then run: node scripts/commercial-invoice.mjs --data <your-file>. Never commit a completed invoice — it contains customer data.
serviceLocation: [Service address — if different from the billing address]

lineItems.description: [Service description — e.g. Commercial cleaning, October 2026 — twice weekly service]

notes: [Scope notes — what was cleaned, the schedule, anything excluded]
